summary: Iteration 10 — Apple/Linear/Notion polish + disabled-state bug fix verification (frontend only). All four step CTAs (step1/2/3-submit-btn, step4-generate-btn) now correctly DISABLED when their mandatory inputs are empty/missing, and ENABLE when filled. Disabled rendering is unmistakable: light-grey gradient (rgb(236,236,234) → rgb(220,220,216)), grey text (rgb(154,154,149)), cursor:not-allowed, soft inset shadow, NO blue gradient, NO drop-glow. Enabled rendering uses the clay-signal blue gradient (rgb(45,84,255) → rgb(0,51,255) → rgb(0,38,194)) with white text and signal-blue glow shadow. Visual polish verified: card-brut radius 14px with soft drop shadow (no harsh 4px 4px 0px brutalist offset), textarea-brut radius 12px with glass background and signal-blue focus ring, btn-brut/btn-ghost radius 10px, step-nav pills border-radius 999px with glass active state. New .page-enter class is present on StepShell root, getComputedStyle().animationName === 'pageEnter' confirmed. No webpack/Babel parse errors (the previously reported orphan code at line 1620 is gone — compile is clean with only pre-existing eslint hook-deps warnings). No pageerror events. Only console error observed is the expected 400 from /api/suggest when partial is empty (test-script artifact, not a regression).
